Backend: 11/11 pytest cases passed (auth guarded /auth/me & /data 401, seeded-session Bearer auth 200, PUT+GET /data round-trip persists profile/history/settings/meal, logout invalidates token, /auth/session missing header 400 + fake session 401, /meal/generate returns valid title/day_calories/day_protein_g/meals[4]/tips[] via Emergent LLM). Frontend: landing shows google-signin-btn + continue-guest-btn + footer-terms-link; guest → onboarding → /app persistence via bits_in_motion_data + bits_mode=guest works; Terms page (terms-content + terms-back) works. Cookie-seeded auth flow loads /app directly with account-menu-trigger showing 'Cookie Tester' (not 'Guest'); settings change (age 27, goal endurance) persists to Mongo via PUT /api/data (verified curl GET /api/data returned the new values); logout-btn signs out and returns to landing. Fuel AI: diet-veg + budget-low + allergies=peanuts → 4 meal-card-* rendered; plan persists across reload. Session Target ring on /coach/squats: target-20 selectable, start-camera-button starts session, target-card + target-ring render, rep-counter shows '0 / 20' (static fake webcam, expected 0 reps). Exercise filter: STRENGTH/none vs ENDURANCE/none tiles differ (Endurance = birddog/highknees/jumpingjacks/plank/pushups/tricepdips — bug from iteration 1 is FIXED). Low-impact swap for fatburn surfaces wallsit/marching/stepjacks correctly. BUG FOUND: STRENGTH/backpack recommended tiles are IDENTICAL to STRENGTH/none — none of the 6 backpack-gear exercises (backpacksquats, backpacklunges, backpackpushups, backpackhipthrust, backpackgoodmorning, backpackcalfraise) surface in Recommended Drills because bodyweight items appear first in EXERCISES object and fill the limit=6 before any backpack variant is reached.

ui_bugs.issue: Backpack equipment does NOT surface Backpack-* weighted variants. STRENGTH/backpack returns identical tiles to STRENGTH/none [squats, pushups, lunges, jumpsquats, pikepushups, tricepdips]. Root cause: Object.values(EXERCISES) yields bodyweight items first; filter allows both gear==='none' and gear==='backpack' when backpack is set, and .slice(0,6) cuts the list before any backpack variant is reached. Fix: when profile.equipment==='backpack', either (a) prioritize gear==='backpack' entries first, e.g. list.sort((a,b) => (b.gear==='backpack') - (a.gear==='backpack')), or (b) split into buckets and interleave, or (c) increase limit for the backpack case.

issues: Recharts still logs width(-1)/height(-1) warnings on initial paint (carried over from iterations 1-2; cosmetic).

rca of the issue: recommendedExercises(profile, limit=6) in /app/frontend/src/lib/exercises.js iterates Object.values(EXERCISES). EXERCISES is defined with all bodyweight (gear:'none') items BEFORE backpack variants. Filter keeps both gear==='none' and gear==='backpack' when profile.equipment==='backpack'. Because insertion order gives bodyweight items indices 0..N first, and slice(0,6) cuts the list at 6 results, no backpack variant ever appears in the recommendation. Mitigation: `list.sort((a,b) => (b.gear==='backpack')-(a.gear==='backpack'))` before slice, or interleave [1 backpack, 1 bodyweight, ...] pattern, or reserve half the slots for backpack when equipment==='backpack'.
